reported.quote: During the financial year, revenue from operations of IRCTC stood at Rs. 5,215 crores
EBITDA stood at Rs. 1,666 crores, registering an increase of approximately 7% from previous year.
During the financial year, PAT stood at Rs. 1,393 crores, registering an increase of approximately 6% from previous year.
The company has also declared and paid the highest dividend in the Financial Year 2025-26 of Rs. 720 crores
IRCTC recorded its highest ever revenue from operations at Rs. 5,215 crores in the Financial Year 2025-26 compared to Rs. 4,675 crores in FY 2024-25 registering a year-on-year growth of 11.55%
IRCTC recorded its highest ever total revenue of Rs. 5,475 crores in FY 2025-26
IRCTC also recorded its highest ever profit before tax of Rs. 1,875 crores
Similarly, the EBITDA grew from Rs. 1,550 crores in FY 2024-25 to Rs. 1,666 crores in FY 2025-26 registering a growth of 7.48%.
The catering segment recorded a revenue of Rs. 2,399 crores in FY 2025-26
The Rail Neer segment recorded a revenue of Rs. 391 crores
The internet ticketing segment recorded a revenue of Rs. 1,536 crores in FY 2025-26
The tourism segment recorded a revenue of Rs. 890 crores in FY 2025-26
The total revenue from operations stood at Rs. 1,460 crores in Q4 of FY 2025-26
There was a marginal dip in the comparative profit figures in Q4 with profits at Rs. 447 crores
EBITDA for the quarter stood at Rs. 399 crores with a healthy EBITDA margin of 27.33%.
